about: T-575 (DRAFT): TOUCH. (1) A gift a person hands over -- the TEA from the old woman in CELADON's condominiums -- with a STRATUM daemon following (SANDSHREW) brings the read 'A read: this was held a long time / before it was given.'; with a daemon of another type following (ARCANINE), nothing. gReadsDebugAlways 1 takes away the chance, so the read is filmed without waiting for it. (2) At night in DAEMON TOWER with a LATENT daemon following (GASTLY), the first step brings 'A read: rain on stone. / It is dry in here.' -- and only once that night. THE SUBTLE LAYER given through DEBUG -> GAME EVENTS. The theatre's debug scratch save; the watch, the flags and the party put back as far as they matter.
